interface.name: astrea_screen_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: Captures the latest compositor-published, acquire-ready scene for one output. The only version 1 format is RGBA8888. Capture has no physical presentation authority and does not include the cursor.

request.name: capture_window

description.summary: capture one window, including retained minimized content

request.description: Capture the window identified by its Astrea toplevel identifier without activating it. The image includes its committed surface tree, excludes unrelated windows and the cursor, and fits within max_width/max_height without upscaling. Limits must be between 1 and 1024. The shell must be authenticated on this connection. Ordinary failures include busy, window_gone, invalid_size and render_failed. Since version 3 the limits may be up to 4096, and the capture sends window_size before ready.

interface.name: astrea_screen_capture_v1
interface.description: The fd is a sealed memfd containing exactly stride times height bytes in top-left RGBA8888 order. The client owns the received fd after the event.

event.name: window_size

description.summary: logical size of the captured window

event.description: Sent once before ready for window captures: the window's visible size in compositor logical pixels, independent of the scaled image size.
